query:
SELECT p.empresa, o.etapa, LEFT(o.observacao, 80) as obs_preview, o.registrado_por, o.created_at 
FROM cobranca_etapa_obs o 
JOIN cobranca_planilha p ON o.planilha_id = p.id 
WHERE p.ativo = 1 
ORDER BY p.empresa, o.created_at DESC 
LIMIT 20;
